title: Fu Jen Catholic University Scholarship for New Students
deadline_central_display: 14 October 2026 23:59 (Spring 2027 round); Fall 2027 first round closes 4 December 2026 23:59
deadline_note: Applications for the Fall 2027 first round open 15 October 2026 at 13:00 and close 4 December 2026 at 23:59, with preliminary review from 5 to 21 December 2026 (except the College of Medicine, 5 to 11 December) and secondary review (thesis/project and interview) on 26 December 2026. Results are announced 8 January 2027 with registration payment due 8 to 21 January 2027. A second round runs 1 March to 15 May 2027 with results on 9 July 2027 and registration payment in July. The Spring 2027 application period was 14 September 2026 13:00 to 14 October 2026 23:59.
application_cycle: Two rounds per cycle: first round 15 October to 4 December, second round 1 March to 15 May (Fall 2027), plus a Spring 2027 window from 14 September 2026 13:00
status_note: The Fall 2027 first round opens on 15 October 2026 at 13:00, immediately after the Spring 2027 window closed on 14 October 2026 at 23:59.
tuition_coverage_note: Fu Jen states 'Tuition and miscellaneous fees are waived or reduced as part of the scholarship and the recipient receives a stipend of NT$50,000 per semester', cautioning that 'The scholarship is subject to change. Please refer to the admission brochure of that semester as accurate'.
benefits: Tuition and miscellaneous fees waived or reduced as part of the scholarship
A stipend of NT$50,000 per semester for new international students in doctoral degree programmes
The stipend is disbursed in monthly instalments of NT$10,000 after the recipient completes registration for the semester
The scholarship is awarded for eight consecutive semesters for doctoral programmes
A separate Love for Ukraine Scholarship Programme provides NT$150,000 per semester over 8 semesters for undergraduate, 4 for master's and 6 for doctoral programmes
eligibility: New international students applying for admission to a Fu Jen Catholic University degree programme who request the scholarship when applying for admission on the online system
The scholarship begins in the semester for which the recipient was granted admission, after the recipient has completed registration
Special scholarship enquiries should be addressed to the International Students Admission Section
requirements: Request the scholarship when applying for admission on the online application system
Complete registration for the semester before the scholarship begins
Pay the application fee of NT$1,600 for domestic remittance or USD 65 for overseas remittance and upload the remittance receipt with the online application
For the doctoral scholarship, the award covers eight consecutive semesters beginning with the semester of admission
coverage: Tuition and miscellaneous fees waived or reduced
A stipend of NT$50,000 per semester paid in monthly instalments of NT$10,000
application_method: Apply online through the international student application system, requesting the scholarship during the admission application and uploading the application fee remittance receipt
application_route: Request the scholarship while applying for admission on the online system; paper submissions are not accepted and the application fee remittance receipt must be uploaded.
duration: Eight consecutive semesters for doctoral degree programmes
description: Fu Jen Catholic University awards scholarships to new international students in undergraduate, master's and doctoral degree programmes, with doctoral students receiving a tuition and miscellaneous fee waiver plus a stipend of NT$50,000 per semester over eight consecutive semesters.

not_confirmed: whether the recorded 'reduced' option for fees applies in practice
verification.notes: Doctoral scholarship terms (tuition and miscellaneous fees waived or reduced, NT$50,000 per semester stipend paid in NT$10,000 monthly instalments, eight consecutive semesters) were read directly from the Fu Jen Catholic University International Students Section scholarships page, which states the university will not accept correspondence or telephone enquiries about the application. Fall 2027 and Spring 2027 application periods, the online application portal, the application fee and the no-paper-submission rule were read from Fu Jen's international student admission page for the Fall 2026/Spring 2027 round. The university cautions that 'The scholarship is subject to change. Please refer to the admission brochure of that semester as accurate', so the admission brochure for the relevant semester is the authoritative source and the record's currency could not be dated.

applicant_utility: This is the doctoral package, and it is a long one - eight consecutive semesters rather than a first-year only award, which makes it worth targeting over a shorter scholarship even at a slightly lower headline value. The structure is a fee waiver or reduction plus NT$50,000 a semester, paid as NT$10,000 monthly instalments once you have registered, so treat it as income rather than a lump sum you can plan around in September. Request it while you are applying for admission on the online system: it is not a separate later application. Two practical points. The online application portal rejects paper submissions entirely and requires the application fee remittance receipt to be uploaded - NT$1,600 for domestic remittance, USD 65 overseas - so get the payment done before you start the form. And note Fu Jen's own caution that the scholarship is subject to change and that the admission brochure for your semester is the accurate source, so confirm the terms when you apply rather than relying on any summary.
